rationale: Selected on rebalance-phase STABILITY, not on the maximum of a phase distribution. correction_2026-09-02: FIELD CORRECTED AFTER FREEZING, DISCLOSED IN FULL. The originally written value of 'score_method' was 'zscore_sum', which is NOT a value the code accepts - signals.composite_score() raises ValueError on it. It was a typo in the parameter dict passed to freeze_design(), never a description of an executed run. The Strategy object that produced every published number did not set score_method at all and therefore used the dataclass default, 'rank' (cross-sectional percentile rank, then the equal-weighted average across legs). The field now records 'rank', the method that actually ran. NO STRATEGY PARAMETER WAS CHANGED and no result moved: re-running the strategy rebuilt strictly from this file reproduces Total Net PNL Rs 27,392,323, CAGR 30.2332%, MDD -27.1571%, 130 round trips and 320 legs, identical to the submitted workbook.
